form.label: SSH Operations Monitoring Dashboard
form.description: Operational visibility for SSH infrastructure and user activity

search.query: index=linux_secure sourcetype=linux_secure "Accepted password" | stats count as total_logins
index=linux_secure sourcetype=linux_secure "Failed password" | stats count as total_failures

index=linux_secure sourcetype=linux_secure | rex "((?Accepted|Failed) password)" | search event_type=* | stats count(eval(event_type="Accepted")) as successes, count(eval(event_type="Failed")) as failures | eval success_rate = round(successes / (successes + failures) * 100, 2) | table success_rate
index=linux_secure sourcetype=linux_secure "Accepted password" | rex "Accepted password for (?\S+)" | stats dc(target_user) as unique_users
index=linux_secure sourcetype=linux_secure | rex "((?Accepted|Failed) password)" | search event_type=* | bucket _time span=1h | stats count by _time, event_type | sort _time

panel.title: Login Heatmap (Hour vs Day of Week)

search.query: index=linux_secure sourcetype=linux_secure "Accepted password" | eval hour = strftime(_time, "%H") | eval dow = strftime(_time, "%A") | stats count by hour, dow | sort hour, dow
index=linux_secure sourcetype=linux_secure "Accepted password" | rex "Accepted password for (?\S+)" | stats count by target_user | sort - count | head 15
index=linux_secure sourcetype=linux_secure | rex "Accepted (?password|publickey|keyboard-interactive|gssapi-with-mic)" | search auth_method=* | stats count by auth_method

index=linux_secure sourcetype=linux_secure "Accepted password" | rex "Accepted password for (?\S+) from (?\S+)" | eval login_hour = strftime(_time, "%H") | eval login_dow = strftime(_time, "%u") | where login_hour < 7 OR login_hour > 19 OR login_dow >= 6 | lookup geoip src_ip OUTPUT city, country | sort - _time | table _time, target_user, src_ip, city, country, login_hour
